subject: experian

matches.evidence: KFG contains a direct TAB edge from the Learn more about our services link to the Terms of Use Agreement link. The navigation positions are 6 -> 7, which are consecutive. Screenshot and DOM descriptors support a region boundary from main page content below the sign-in card to the footer.

This is a verified direct TAB transition between distinct functional subgroups: the main-content promotional/service link and the footer legal-links group. The destination position is exactly one greater than the source (6 -> 7).

KFG shows a direct TAB edge from the Forgot username link to the Learn more about our services link. The source is a recovery/helper link. In inferred meaningful order, primary workflow controls Password input (position 4) and Sign In button (position 5) lie between source position 3 and destination position 6.

uncertain.reason: The source is clearly a recovery link, but the destination Learn more about our services link appears promotional/informational rather than clearly a secondary support/utility control within the same local functional group.

matches.evidence: KFG verifies a direct TAB edge from Password input to Sign In button. Their navigation positions are consecutive (4 -> 5), and they are visually/functionally distinct subgroups within the sign-in module: an input field followed by the form's primary action button.

KFG contains a direct TAB edge from the Sign In button (position 5) to the Experian logo link in the header (position 1), moving from a later control back to an earlier top-of-page control, which is a wraparound/cyclic focus edge.

KFG verifies a direct TAB transition from Username input to Password input. A separate focusable helper/recovery link is visually associated with the destination field group: the Forgot password link appears adjacent to the password field in the screenshot and is represented in the KFG as /form/div[3]/div[2]/a[1].

KFG shows a direct TAB edge from the primary Username input to the later Password input within the sign-in module. A separate visible focusable control occupies the intermediate position: the Forgot username link is navigation position 3, visually placed near the username field, between Username input (position 2) and Password input (position 4).

KFG contains a direct TAB edge from Terms of Use Agreement to Privacy Policy. Both are nearby footer links serving secondary/legal/support functions within the same local footer link group, and the screenshot shows them adjacent.
This is a verified direct TAB transition with consecutive meaningful positions 7 -> 8 between two clearly distinct but adjacent footer link items in the same footer subgrouping.

uncertain.reason: Privacy Policy is a secondary footer/legal link, but the destination McAfee Secure link appears to be a trust badge/security link. The evidence does not clearly establish that both endpoints serve the same local auxiliary/support role required by the pattern.

The transition is direct and consecutive in navigation order (8 -> 9), but the evidence is insufficient to establish that Privacy Policy and McAfee Secure are clearly distinct adjacent functional subgroups rather than just neighboring items within the same footer area.

McAfee Secure and Licenses and Disclosures are both footer items, but the evidence does not clearly show that both are genuinely secondary utility/support controls within the same local functional group rather than separate footer sections.

The KFG verifies a direct TAB edge and the positions are consecutive (9 -> 10), but the screenshot/DOM evidence does not clearly establish distinct adjacent visual or functional subgroups between the McAfee badge link area and the Licenses and Disclosures link.

matches.evidence: This candidate is explicitly a Browser boundary transition. The KFG v_special marks the Username input as both v_0 and v_entry, and the candidate transition is Browser -> Username input.

subject_summary: Observed patterns include browser entry to the username field, wraparound from the Sign In button to the header logo, a helper-link-to-later-content transition crossing primary workflow controls, a field-to-field jump over an intermediate helper link, and a clear main-to-footer adjacent cross-region transition. Footer legal-link progression is supported for Terms of Use -> Privacy Policy, while some later footer transitions remain ambiguous about subgroup or auxiliary-role boundaries.
